title: Harish-Chandra D-modules for bi-Whittaker reduction
summary: Let $D(G)$ be the algebra of algebraic differential operators on a complex reductive group $G$. Denote by $\mathbb{W}$ the bi-Whittaker quantum Hamiltonian reduction of $D(G)$, also known as the quantum Toda lattice. In this article we define the admissible $\mathbb{W}$-modules and the special case of Harish-Chandra modules, the latter being bi-Whittaker variants of the invariant holonomic systems of Hotta-Kashiwara.
